WA 24 Šanghaj - Na snímke španielsky tenista Alejandro Davidovich Fokina sa teší z výhry proti Alexandrovi Zverevovi z Nemecka po  semifinálovom dueli mužskej dvojhry na turnaji ATP Masters 1000 v čínskom Šanghaji v sobotu 17. októbra 2026. Fokina zvíťazil v troch setoch 5:7, 6:4 a 6:3. FOTO TASR/AP


Spain's Alejandro Davidovich Fokina celebrates after winning the men's singles semifinal match against Germany's Alexander Zverev at the Shanghai Masters tennis tournament in Shanghai, China, Saturday, Oct. 17, 2026. (AP Photo/Andy Wong)

WA 23 Šanghaj - Na snímke nemecký tenista Alexander Zverev (vľavo) a španielsky tenista Alejandro Davidovich Fokina sa objímajú po  semifinálovom dueli mužskej dvojhry na turnaji ATP Masters 1000 v čínskom Šanghaji v sobotu 17. októbra 2026. Fokina zvíťazil v troch setoch 5:7, 6:4 a 6:3. FOTO TASR/AP


Spain's Alejandro Davidovich Fokina is congratulated by Germany's Alexander Zverev after winning the men's singles semifinal match at the Shanghai Masters tennis tournament in Shanghai, China, Saturday, Oct. 17, 2026. (AP Photo/Andy Wong)

Germany's Alexander Zverev leaves the court after losing against Spain's Alejandro Davidovich Fokina during the men's singles semifinal match at the Shanghai Masters tennis tournament in Shanghai, China, Saturday, Oct. 17, 2026. (AP Photo/Andy Wong)
